scope: First 88 of 144 accepted NCERT Arts source records: 6 formal Foundational stage records, 30 suggestive Grades 1–2 positions and 52 formal Preparatory records. The separate 56 nongraded shared-stage syllabus positions remain pending. This is the selected NCERT national primary baseline, not every Indian board.
coverageMeaning: Full accounts for complete source-fit authoring tasks and conditions, not child observations or mastery certification. Every graph association is a component contribution; contextual affect and school form/resource bindings stay explicit.
stageAndChoice: Formal Foundational 3–8 and Preparatory 8–11 are official stage windows with stage-end reference, not identical expectations at every age. Selected Grades 1–2 and suggestive primary 6–8 do not rewrite the formal stage. LS1 resource provision and LS2 initial baseline are source applicability sets, not taxonomy difficulty levels.

existingGuideReview.guideLimits: All other closure cards have no guide. Both available guides were read in full and remain unchanged. Mark-making guidance is original/untested; historical pattern-guide flags are not fresh efficacy evidence. A legacy pattern feedback typo is not used as an assessment criterion. No unrelated research correction is included.

conditionalRepresentation: The four LS2 records retain all original keys and parameterised source-fit tasks. Only form-independent required components receive flat links; twelve form-specific candidate contributions are withheld until the school programme/resources are bound. Alternatives are not simultaneous universal requirements, and no national art-form choice is requested.
